# Fact sheet — Aoife Brennan

Sources: `material/linkedin.md` (LinkedIn profile, saved as text, October 2026), `material/notes.md` (notes sent directly to me), `material/poster-abstract.md` (conference poster abstract, Irish Nursing Informatics Conference 2025).

## Who she is, in her own words

"Eleven years a nurse, six of them in charge of a shift. I got into informatics the night Mr D. in bed 14 nearly got another man's warfarin, because the scanner trolley was at the far end of the ward. Since then I have been the person who asks why the system makes the safe thing the slow thing." — *linkedin.md*

Part-time MSc in Health Informatics, in progress. — *linkedin.md*

- BSc General Nursing, Liffey University, 2011–2015. — *linkedin.md*
- Staff Nurse, Coronary Care Unit, St Brendan's University Hospital, Sep 2015–Aug 2019. — *linkedin.md*
- Clinical Nurse Manager 1, Cardiac Step-Down (28 beds), St Brendan's University Hospital, Sep 2019–present. — *linkedin.md*
- MSc Health Informatics (part-time), Liffey University, 2024–2026. — *linkedin.md*

**Answer:** [pending]

## Each job

### Staff Nurse, Coronary Care Unit (Sep 2015–Aug 2019)
No achievements or activities listed anywhere in the material. — *gap*

### CNM1, Cardiac Step-Down, 28 beds (Sep 2019–present)
- Led the redesign of the nursing handover sheet, now used on 6 wards. — *linkedin.md*
- Barcode medication scanning from 71% to 94% in 9 months. — *linkedin.md*, corroborated in detail by *poster-abstract.md*
- Preceptor to 14 newly qualified nurses. — *linkedin.md*
- Built dashboards for the falls and pressure ulcer audits. — *linkedin.md*

**Answer:** [pending]

## The title

LinkedIn headline says "Clinical Informatics Lead and CNM1, Cardiac Step-Down." Her own note says: "My manager calls me the informatics lead. On paper I am the Nursing Informatics Link Nurse, one day a week." — *notes.md*

**This is a disagreement.** The LinkedIn headline and the formal title are not the same thing, and the gap is a day of the week. — *to confirm*

**Answer:** [pending]

## The project behind the numbers: the scanning study

- On her ward, 29% of medication doses were given without scanning both wristband and medicine. — *poster-abstract.md*
- She observed for 40 hours across day and night shifts, and ran short interviews with 22 nurses. — *poster-abstract.md*
- Three workarounds accounted for most missed scans: wristbands that would not scan after a shower, scanners kept on a trolley away from the medication room, and scanning from a printed sheet of barcodes kept in a pocket. — *poster-abstract.md*
- Each workaround saved a nurse between one and four minutes a round; none was laziness. — *poster-abstract.md*
- What changed: scanners were fixed beside the medication room door, the wristband stock was changed, and the printed sheets stopped. Scanning rose to 94% in nine months. — *poster-abstract.md*
- Presented as a poster, Irish Nursing Informatics Conference 2025, single author (A. Brennan, RGN). — *poster-abstract.md*

**Answer:** [pending — whose decision was it to make these three changes, and whose to carry them out?]

Her manager calls her "the informatics lead," informally. — *notes.md*

No other quotes, references or recommendations are in the material. — *gap*

The near-miss with Mr D. in bed 14, which she names as the start of her interest in informatics. — *linkedin.md*

No book, course or person is named as a source of learning, beyond the MSc itself. — *gap*

## Pictures, drawings or files she says she has

- A photo of the ward whiteboard from a night with nine admissions. "It says everything about the job." — *notes.md*. Not yet supplied as a file.
- The old handover sheet and the new one (the one she redesigned). — *notes.md*. Not yet supplied as files.

**Answer:** [pending]

## Skills

ISBAR handover, Medication safety, Audit, SQL (basic), Power BI. — *linkedin.md*

---

- Nothing to show for the four years as Staff Nurse, Coronary Care Unit.
- The whiteboard photo and the two handover sheets are described but not yet supplied as files.
- Nothing documenting the MSc itself — no coursework, dissertation topic, or placement.
